approximations.description: The publication states nd and vd only; those two numbers do not define a dispersion curve. Each glass is a three-term Sellmeier at the fixed poles (0.0035, 0.0125, 90) um^2 solved to a published catalog glass of the same (nd, vd) region, corrected with an affine term so it reproduces the printed nd and vd exactly. The index at the d line is the source's; the dispersion between the F, d and C lines is a model and the partial dispersion PgF is not reproduced.

The printed nd is a refractive index relative to air. The Project stores absolute indices (the printed value times the engine's air index at the d line), so the engine's air-referenced paraxial trace recovers the printed nd and the printed focal length.
The publication states no clear apertures. Each semi-diameter is the envelope of the axial marginal ray at the stated f-number and the chief ray at the stated field, plus 4 percent and 0.20 mm.
Each element is given one cylindrical outline radius: the largest that keeps 0.40 mm of glass at its edge, and that keeps consecutive surfaces 0.15 mm apart (0.40 mm across a glass).
The publication states no stop-plate outer radius; the plate reaches the largest clear semi-diameter beside the stop.
No flange, barrel, filter or mounting geometry is stated or claimed.
Nominal prescription surfaces; no figure, centring or roughness error is modelled.

The publication states the object-space field (2w up to 185.73 deg, a fisheye) but no clear apertures. The clear apertures here are derived from the marginal ray at the stated f-number and a chief ray at the angle whose paraxial image height is the printed image height Y at the printed focal length, not at half the printed field angle: at 92.9 deg a paraxial chief ray does not describe the beam that the front group actually delivers to the stop, and the derived outlines overlap between elements. The image height is the publication's own number; the angle is derived from it.

The beam envelope exceeds the element outline on 21 surface(s), so the clear aperture is set to the outline and the extreme field is vignetted there: surface 1 (beam 47.57 mm, outline 43.61 mm), surface 3 (beam 33.32 mm, outline 25.09 mm), surface 4 (beam 31.26 mm, outline 25.09 mm), surface 5 (beam 20.77 mm, outline 17.84 mm), surface 6 (beam 18.72 mm, outline 17.84 mm), surface 9 (beam 14.03 mm, outline 13.58 mm), surface 10 (beam 15.09 mm, outline 13.58 mm), surface 12 (beam 18.28 mm, outline 16.75 mm), surface 13 (beam 18.48 mm, outline 18.45 mm), surface 15 (beam 18.24 mm, outline 17.70 mm), surface 16 (beam 18.18 mm, outline 17.70 mm), surface 19 (beam 17.65 mm, outline 17.59 mm), surface 21 (beam 17.39 mm, outline 17.06 mm), surface 23 (beam 17.16 mm, outline 17.06 mm), surface 24 (beam 17.15 mm, outline 16.69 mm), surface 26 (beam 16.65 mm, outline 14.67 mm), surface 28 (beam 14.53 mm, outline 13.75 mm), surface 31 (beam 14.21 mm, outline 13.60 mm), surface 32 (beam 14.38 mm, outline 13.60 mm), surface 34 (beam 16.01 mm, outline 14.96 mm), surface 36 (beam 22.84 mm, outline 22.26 mm)
